# Expression engine human review sheet

Use this sheet only with outputs from a deliberately enabled test adapter and fictional isolated data. The checked-in scenario file contains no generated answers. Do not infer a quality score from unit tests.

For each scenario, reviewers may assign 1–5 (1 = poor, 3 = acceptable, 5 = strong) for: naturalness, character voice, situational fit, factual grounding, continuity, non-repetition/non-pressure, and technical accuracy (where relevant). Add one sentence of evidence for each score. Mark “N/A” where the dimension does not apply. A second reviewer should independently score before comparing notes.
